shared.QuestSettingsCard.noYetiHugIn: No Yeti hug in solo quests
shared.QuestSettingsCard.shortRemindersO: Short reminders of rules the app does not enforce: terrain and special rooms the first time they are seen, and moving without rolling when no monster is awake.
shared.QuestSettingsCard.theseAreSetWhen: These are set when a campaign has started. Start a game in Campaign mode first.
textures.packCouldNotBeLoaded: This texture pack could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

Tap a picture to adjust it.
theme.TexturesDialog.aTexturePackChanges: A texture pack changes how the board looks: floor, walls, doors, furniture and monster pictures. It never changes the rules or your saved games.
theme.TexturesDialog.builtInLook: Built-in look: no pack in use.

theme.TexturesDialog.thisFileIsToo: This file is too big for a texture pack (about 10 MB at most).
translations.aTranslationChangesThe: A translation changes the words of the app and of the quests. It never changes the rules or your saved games. A text that a language does not have is shown in English.
translations.builtInEnglish: {total} texts · {edited} changed by you · Stays on this device. English cannot be deleted.

translations.msgCodeTaken: There is a language with this code already.
translations.msgNotJson: This file is not a translation file: it is not valid JSON.
translations.msgNotStored: The translation could not be stored on this device.
translations.msgTooBig: This file is too big for a translation (5 MB at most).
translations.msgTooMany: This translation has too many texts.
translations.name: Name
translations.noTranslationYetMake: No translation yet. Make one from English, or import a {LANGUAGE_EXTENSION} file.

translations.resetDone: English is back to the original texts.
translations.theNewLanguageStarts: The new language starts as a copy of the English texts, ready to change.
zargon.alreadyCast: It already cast a spell this turn.
zargon.fighterMovesBack: Move in and attack. Already next to a hero: attack, then move back out of reach.
zargon.fighterStays: Move in and attack. Already next to a hero: attack and stay.
zargon.freshNote: It already attacked this round. Its order starts next turn.
zargon.grapplerHugs: Already hugging a hero: it does nothing else. Otherwise: move in and attack.
zargon.grapplerSolo: Move in and attack. (In a solo quest it does not hug.)
zargon.guardsMarker: Guards the marked square: it stays close to it and only attacks a hero who comes near.
zargon.guardsMarkerNamed: Guards the marked square "{label}": it stays close to it and only attacks a hero who comes near.
zargon.multiAttack: {lines} If the last target is out of reach, hit the first target again. It moves only once.
zargon.noAttacker: If nobody has attacked it yet, use the tie list.
zargon.noCaster: If no Wizard or Elf is in reach, use the tie list.
zargon.noGrudge: If the {hero} is out of reach, use the tie list.
zargon.noIsolated: If no hero is cut off like that, use the tie list.
zargon.passiveNote: Passive: no orders. If the heroes free it or it leaves, tap "It left". If a hero attacks it, tap "A hero attacked it".
zargon.raimentGrappler: Raiment of the Frozen Champion: it cannot hug a hero carrying the Spiked Shield.
zargon.raimentThief: Raiment of the Frozen Champion: it cannot steal from a hero wearing the Cold Iron Plate Mail.
zargon.shooterOpen: A hero in sight, not next to it: shoot, do not move. No hero in sight: move until one is, then shoot.
zargon.shooterStays: {open} Starts next to a hero: melee and stay.
zargon.shooterStepsBack: {open} Starts next to a hero: step back out of contact and shoot; if it cannot, melee and stay.
zargon.soloNoHug: Solo quest: it does not hug. Ignore the hug rule above.
zargon.stayPut: Stays where it is. It only attacks a hero next to it.
zargon.thiefSteals: Steal: move next to the target and steal instead of attacking. Suggested item: a potion if the hero has one, otherwise the most valuable item they carry. Only a hero can be robbed: if the target is not a hero, attack it instead.
zargon.towardMarker: Goes toward the marked square, not the nearest hero.
zargon.towardMarkerNamed: Goes toward the marked square "{label}", not the nearest hero.
zargon.towardStrongest: Goes toward the hero with the most Body Points left, not the nearest.
zargon.towardWeakest: Goes toward the hero with the fewest Body Points left, not the nearest.
zargon.waitsAdjacent: Waits: it does nothing until a hero is next to it.
zargon.waitsRoom: Waits: it does nothing until a hero is in its room.
zargon.waitsSight: Waits: it does nothing until a hero is in its line of sight.
